Link radar, September 10, 2026

The daily link radar for September 10 collects five verified primary-source reads with builder notes and source links, shipped alongside this release record in a single change set.

Follow the journal ↗

The September tenth radar collects five primary-source reads from early September, each verified reachable on the day of curation, with a companion release record in the same change set. This entry records the change from the assigned issue record only.

Motivation

Builders need a short daily list of primary sources with a note on why each one matters, instead of a feed of aggregator links. A fixed radar shape with one intro line, five titled items, two-line builder notes, and source links keeps the habit cheap to read and cheap to verify. Shipping the release record beside the article keeps provenance attached to the content it describes.

What changed

A new radar article went live with five summarized reads plus source links and distribution copy for social and feed surfaces. A matching release record landed in the same change set covering motivation, changes, implementation, agent trail, and evidence. The digest links to the journal and the build log; no templates, styles, or generator logic were touched.

How it was done

The work ran on a short branch cut from the main line. The curation arrived verified from the owning editor, the article and release record were drafted from the scaffold helpers, the distribution copy was written beside the article, and the site was rebuilt with the full suite green. The change ships with this release record in the same pull request.

Agent trail

The implementation owner ran the remote preflight, cut the branch, wrote the article and the release record, and rebuilt the site. Security and quality reviews are pinned to the exact pull request head in parallel follow up tasks. The release record here is updated after approval and merge.

Verification evidence

The site build exits success, the full unit suite is green, and the presence gate prints success. The article markup passes the publish gate, every external link uses a secure scheme, and the release record covers all five standing sections with a dated step trail.

Why each step ran.

DEV
The radar reuses the established radar layout and the builder defaults for external links, so no new visual language was introduced. Summaries are paraphrased in our own words with links to the originals, keeping the article within the markup allowlist. The release record ships in the same change set so the presence gate stays satisfied.
Director
This change adds routine dated content inside the cleared pattern with no new pages or components. Security and quality reviews are pinned to the exact pull request head in follow up tasks. Release approval fires only when both verdicts pass that exact head.
